status: preregistered after R53A and before any matched R54 target launch
finding_that_motivated_this_test: R53A eliminated every .best_config artifact and passed the full workload and canary gates at 51.7965 tok/s, but matched the older R51 targets only 8/12. Generated R53 kernels use deterministic=true and autotune_pointwise=false, whereas generated R51 kernels used the earlier effective deterministic=false/autotune_pointwise=true compiler context. Comparing treatment and target under different reduction-order contracts cannot qualify speculative exactness.
treatment: Run both MTP0 target and MTP1 candidate from the identical content-verified R50 image and compile both with the identical explicit vLLM compilation configuration: combo_kernels=false, benchmark_combo_kernel=false, deterministic=true, triton.autotune_pointwise=false, and benchmark_epilogue_fusion=false. Keep model, TP2, official FP8, W8A16, XPU Graph off, persistent GDN state, packed Gemma RMSNorm exact replay, seed 0, max-autotune=0, coordinate-descent=0, topology, and all non-speculative settings fixed. MTP1 alone enables one MTP draft token. The first attempted R54 MTP0 launch inherited the older default R15 image; it was stopped before readiness and is explicitly invalidated rather than included in this matrix.
workload: Two fresh MTP0 servers and two fresh MTP1 servers, each with a separate empty compile cache; complete fixed 12-prompt/six-class natural-512 suite; each prompt once; temperature 0; class-balanced 100-event/99-interval decode; prefix cache disabled; cached_tokens=0; complete raw token arrays; independent canaries.
promotion_gate: Every attempt must pass every workload/cache/canary gate. Each target pair and candidate pair must match 12/12 complete token arrays, and all four target-by-candidate comparisons must match 12/12. Candidate class-balanced median must exceed 50 tok/s in both fresh attempts. Generated compiled kernels must use deterministic=true/autotune_pointwise=false and produce no .best_config artifacts.
reporting: R53A is retained as the first candidate member of the matched matrix but was not promoted against the mismatched R51 compiler contract. No headline, package promotion, or external submission until the complete preregistered matrix passes. Preserve all failures.
